017package org.apache.juneau.http.entity;
018
019import static org.apache.juneau.commons.utils.Shorts.*;
020
021import java.io.*;
022import java.nio.charset.*;
023import java.util.*;
024
025import org.apache.juneau.http.*;
026
027/**
028 * An {@link HttpBody} that serializes a {@code multipart/form-data} message (RFC 7578).
029 *
030 * <p>
031 * Each part is a {@link MultipartPart} that carries a field name, an optional filename, an optional
032 * per-part {@code Content-Type}, and a body writer.  When {@link #writeTo(OutputStream)} is called the
033 * parts are streamed directly — no full-body buffering occurs.
034 *
035 * <h5 class='section'>Example:</h5>
036 * <p class='bjava'>
037 *    <jv>body</jv> = MultipartBody.<jsm>builder</jsm>()
038 *       .field(<js>"title"</js>, <js>"My Report"</js>)
039 *       .file(<js>"attachment"</js>, <jv>reportFile</jv>, <js>"application/pdf"</js>)
040 *       .build();
041 * </p>
042 *
043 * <p>
044 * {@link #isRepeatable()} returns {@code false} when any part wraps a one-shot stream, and {@code true}
045 * when all parts are repeatable (e.g. strings, files, byte arrays).
046 *
047 * <p>
048 * <b>Beta — API subject to change:</b> This type is part of the next-generation REST client and HTTP stack.
049 * It is not API-frozen: binary- and source-incompatible changes may appear in the <b>next major</b> Juneau release
050 * (and possibly earlier).
051 * For production use cases that require long-term binary stability, continue using the existing
052 * {@code juneau-rest-client} and {@code juneau-rest-common} APIs until the {@code ng} stack is declared stable.
053 *
054 * <h5 class='section'>See Also:</h5><ul>
055 *    <li class='link'><a class="doclink" href="https://juneau.apache.org/docs/topics/NextGenRestClient">juneau-ng REST client</a>
056 *    <li class='extlink'><a class="doclink" href="https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc7578">RFC 7578 — Returning Values from Forms: multipart/form-data</a>
057 * </ul>
058 *
059 * @since 9.2.1
060 */
061public final class MultipartBody implements HttpBody {
062
063   private static final byte[] CRLF = "\r\n".getBytes(StandardCharsets.US_ASCII);
064   private static final byte[] DASHDASH = "--".getBytes(StandardCharsets.US_ASCII);
065
066   private final String boundary;
067   private final List<MultipartPart> parts;
068
069   /**
070    * Rejects a part-metadata value (name, filename, or content-type) that could inject an extra MIME header line
071    * or otherwise corrupt the multipart framing at the receiving service.
072    *
073    * @param fieldName The name of the field being validated, for the exception message.
074    * @param value The value to validate. Can be <jk>null</jk> (no-op).
075    * @throws IllegalArgumentException If {@code value} contains CR, LF, another C0 control, NEL, or a bidi control.
076    */
077   private static void assertNoInjectionChars(String fieldName, String value) {
078      if (value == null)
079         return;
080      for (var i = 0; i < value.length(); i++)
081         if (isInjectionChar(value.charAt(i)))
082            throw iaex("MultipartPart '%s' must not contain CR, LF, or other control characters.", fieldName);
083   }
084
085   private static boolean isInjectionChar(char c) {
086      if (c == '\t')
087         return false;
088      if (c <= '\u001F')  // C0 controls (CR/LF included).
089         return true;
090      if (c >= '\u007F' && c <= '\u009F')  // DEL + C1 controls (includes NEL \u0085).
091         return true;
092      if (c == '\u2028' || c == '\u2029')  // Line / paragraph separators.
093         return true;
094      if (c >= '\u202A' && c <= '\u202E')  // Bidi embedding/override controls.
095         return true;
096      return c >= '\u2066' && c <= '\u2069';  // Bidi isolate controls.
097   }
098
099   /**
100    * Escapes {@code \} and {@code "} in a {@code Content-Disposition} quoted-string parameter value so it cannot
101    * break out of the surrounding quotes.
102    *
103    * @param value The raw value to escape. Must not be <jk>null</jk>.
104    * @return The escaped value, unquoted (caller adds the surrounding {@code "..."}).
105    */
106   private static String escapeQuoted(String value) {
107      var sb = new StringBuilder(value.length() + 4);
108      for (var i = 0; i < value.length(); i++) {
109         var c = value.charAt(i);
110         if (c == '\\' || c == '"')
111            sb.append('\\');
112         sb.append(c);
113      }
114      return sb.toString();
115   }
116
117   private MultipartBody(String boundary, List<MultipartPart> parts) {
118      this.boundary = boundary;
119      this.parts = List.copyOf(parts);
120   }
121
122   /** Returns a new {@link Builder}. */
123   public static Builder builder() {
124      return new Builder();
125   }
126
127   @Override /* HttpBody */
128   public String getContentType() {
129      return "multipart/form-data; boundary=" + boundary;
130   }
131
132   /**
133    * Returns {@code -1} — multipart bodies are streamed without pre-computing the total length.
134    */
135   @Override /* HttpBody */
136   public long getContentLength() {
137      return -1;
138   }
139
140   @Override /* HttpBody */
141   public void writeTo(OutputStream out) throws IOException {
142      var bnd = boundary.getBytes(StandardCharsets.US_ASCII);
143      for (var part : parts) {
144         // Belt-and-suspenders: MultipartPart's compact constructor already rejects these, but re-validate at
145         // write time in case a part was ever reachable without going through that constructor.
146         assertNoInjectionChars("name", part.name());
147         assertNoInjectionChars("filename", part.filename());
148         assertNoInjectionChars("contentType", part.contentType());
149         out.write(DASHDASH);
150         out.write(bnd);
151         out.write(CRLF);
152         // Content-Disposition header
153         var cd = new StringBuilder("Content-Disposition: form-data; name=\"").append(escapeQuoted(part.name())).append('"');
154         if (part.filename() != null)
155            cd.append("; filename=\"").append(escapeQuoted(part.filename())).append('"');
156         out.write(cd.toString().getBytes(StandardCharsets.UTF_8));
157         out.write(CRLF);
158         // Content-Type header (if present)
159         if (part.contentType() != null) {
160            out.write(("Content-Type: " + part.contentType()).getBytes(StandardCharsets.US_ASCII));
161            out.write(CRLF);
162         }
163         out.write(CRLF);
164         part.body().writeTo(out);
165         out.write(CRLF);
166      }
167      // Final boundary
168      out.write(DASHDASH);
169      out.write(bnd);
170      out.write(DASHDASH);
171      out.write(CRLF);
172   }
173
174   @Override /* HttpBody */
175   public boolean isRepeatable() {
176      for (var part : parts)
177         if (!part.body().isRepeatable())
178            return false;
179      return true;
180   }
181
182   /**
183    * Returns the multipart boundary string.
184    *
185    * @return The boundary. Never <jk>null</jk>.
186    */
187   public String getBoundary() {
188      return boundary;
189   }
190
191   /**
192    * Returns an unmodifiable view of the parts in this multipart body.
193    *
194    * @return The parts. Never <jk>null</jk>.
195    */
196   public List<MultipartPart> getParts() {
197      return parts;
198   }
199
200   // -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
201   // Inner types
202   // -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
203
204   /**
205    * A single part within a {@link MultipartBody}.
206    *
207    * @since 9.2.1
208    */
209   public record MultipartPart(String name, String filename, String contentType, HttpBody body) {
210
211      /**
212       * Compact constructor enforcing the documented non-null contract on {@code name} and {@code body}, and
213       * rejecting CR/LF and other control characters in {@code name}, {@code filename}, and {@code contentType}
214       * that could otherwise inject an extra MIME header line into the multipart wire format.
215       */
216      public MultipartPart {
217         reqnn("name", name);
218         reqnn("body", body);
219         assertNoInjectionChars("name", name);
220         assertNoInjectionChars("filename", filename);
221         assertNoInjectionChars("contentType", contentType);
222      }
223
224      /**
225       * Creates a text field part with no filename and {@code text/plain; charset=UTF-8} content type.
226       *
227       * @param name The field name. Must not be <jk>null</jk>.
228       * @param value The string value. Must not be <jk>null</jk>.
229       * @return A new instance. Never <jk>null</jk>.
230       */
231      public static MultipartPart field(String name, String value) {
232         return new MultipartPart(name, null, "text/plain; charset=UTF-8", StringBody.of(value, "text/plain; charset=UTF-8"));
233      }
234
235      /**
236       * Creates a file upload part.
237       *
238       * @param name The field name. Must not be <jk>null</jk>.
239       * @param file The file to upload. Must not be <jk>null</jk>. Its {@link File#getName()} is validated like any
240       *    other {@code filename} — a hostile name containing CR/LF or other control characters is rejected.
241       * @param contentType The MIME content type for the file (e.g. {@code "application/pdf"}). May be <jk>null</jk>.
242       * @return A new instance. Never <jk>null</jk>.
243       */
244      public static MultipartPart file(String name, File file, String contentType) {
245         reqnn("file", file);
246         return new MultipartPart(name, file.getName(), contentType, FileBody.of(file, contentType));
247      }
248
249      /**
250       * Creates a part from an arbitrary {@link HttpBody}.
251       *
252       * @param name The field name. Must not be <jk>null</jk>.
253       * @param filename The filename to advertise in {@code Content-Disposition}. May be <jk>null</jk>.
254       * @param contentType The MIME content type. May be <jk>null</jk>.
255       * @param body The body content. Must not be <jk>null</jk>.
256       * @return A new instance. Never <jk>null</jk>.
257       */
258      public static MultipartPart of(String name, String filename, String contentType, HttpBody body) {
259         return new MultipartPart(name, filename, contentType, body);
260      }
261   }
262
263   /**
264    * Fluent builder for {@link MultipartBody}.
265    *
266    * <p>
267    * <b>Beta — API subject to change.</b>
268    *
269    * @since 9.2.1
270    */
271   public static final class Builder {
272
273      private String boundary = UUID.randomUUID().toString().replace("-", "");
274      private final List<MultipartPart> parts = l();
275
276      private Builder() {}
277
278      /**
279       * Sets a custom multipart boundary string (defaults to a random UUID-derived value).
280       *
281       * @param value The boundary. Must not be <jk>null</jk> or blank.
282       * @return This object.
283       */
284      public Builder boundary(String value) {
285         boundary = reqnb("value", value);
286         return this;
287      }
288
289      /**
290       * Adds a plain-text form field.
291       *
292       * @param name The field name. Must not be <jk>null</jk>.
293       * @param value The field value. Must not be <jk>null</jk>.
294       * @return This object.
295       */
296      public Builder field(String name, String value) {
297         parts.add(MultipartPart.field(name, value));
298         return this;
299      }
300
301      /**
302       * Adds a file upload part.
303       *
304       * @param name The field name. Must not be <jk>null</jk>.
305       * @param file The file to upload. Must not be <jk>null</jk>.
306       * @param contentType The MIME content type for the file. May be <jk>null</jk>.
307       * @return This object.
308       */
309      public Builder file(String name, File file, String contentType) {
310         parts.add(MultipartPart.file(name, file, contentType));
311         return this;
312      }
313
314      /**
315       * Adds a custom part.
316       *
317       * @param part The part to add. Must not be <jk>null</jk>.
318       * @return This object.
319       */
320      public Builder part(MultipartPart part) {
321         parts.add(reqnn("part", part));
322         return this;
323      }
324
325      /**
326       * Builds and returns the {@link MultipartBody}.
327       *
328       * @return A new instance. Never <jk>null</jk>.
329       */
330      public MultipartBody build() {
331         return new MultipartBody(boundary, parts);
332      }
333   }
334}
